subject: Architect Mini-Demo — priority waves & RSVP split plan
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Architect Mini-Demo — priority waves & RSVP split plan

Hey team,

Drafting the invite cadence and segmentation for the June Architect mini-demo (30 minute technical demo + 20 minute Q&A). High-level plan below — want a quick pass from product and partnerships before we roll outbound.

Key goals:
- Drive 250 qualified RSVPs, 125 live attendees
- Prioritize enterprise architects from mid-market/enterprise accounts (Seed list + account-based reach)
- Enable partner co-host flows for ScaleCloud and a handful of co-sponsors

Proposed waves (staggered by priority):
1) Priority Wave A (Mon 6/5 send): top 350 accounts — personal subject lines, account-specific demo callouts, rep follow-up 48 hours after send
2) Wave B (Wed 6/7 send): developer/product engineer list ~1,200 — shorter copy, example prompts and sample code snippets
3) Wave C (Fri 6/9 send): general nurture + partners — partner co-markets + shared tracking links

Tracking & links (attached sheet):
- Unique RSVP link per wave and per partner (tracking-links-sheet.xlsx)
- UTM scheme: utm_source=redwood&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=arch-mini-demo&utm_term=waveA/B/C&utm_content={segment}

Open items / asks:
- Marissa: can you review copy v3 in the attached and flag any product claims that need toning down?
- Ben: confirm capacity for two simultaneous co-host sessions (we may need to open a second demo slot if >200 live).
- Priyom: please add the partner hubspot seeds and confirm the partner tracking params.

Attachments: invite-copy-v3.docx, rsvp-segmentation.csv, tracking-links-sheet.xlsx

Thanks — aim to lock send lists by EOD Monday so we can finalize the creative.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Growth Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.com

Thanks Logan — quick pass:

- Copy: remove sentence that says "zero infra changes required" (product agreed to "no infra changes for 95% of standard models") — I'll mark the doc.
- Wave timing: can we push Wave B to Thu 6/8 to avoid Wed holiday for some APAC folks? keeping to UTC-friendly sends helps international partners.
- Partner asks: for ScaleCloud we should include a small co-branded CTA rather than just a mention — I'll loop their partner ops contact.

Also: Ben, capacity check? If we do the co-host model and one partner co-hosts a demo slot, do we still need to open a backup session?

Sanjay / Acme events team —

Quick note to invite you to a short Architect-focused demo we're running on June 15: 30 minutes of a technical walkthrough of serving & inference patterns on Redwood, followed by 20 minutes of deep Q&A. We think this will be a good fit for your infra and platform architects.

Why attend:
- Live demo of cost-aware routing and caching primitives (low-latency, multi-model serving)
- Real-world prompt engineering examples and rollout policies for model variants
- Time for product Q&A and a brief look at Dedicated and Private deployment options

RSVP: https://events.redwood.com/rsvp?acct=acmeai&utm_campaign=arch-mini-demo&utm_content=waveA
(If you'd prefer a private walkthrough for your infra team, happy to schedule — just reply with preferred dates.)

We partnered with ScaleCloud on some of the deployment examples and they'll be co-hosting the session; we can reserve priority seats for AcmeAI.

Best,
